description: This file implements a SQL-based session store for Mattermost, including methods for saving, retrieving, updating, deleting, and cleaning up user sessions, as well as gathering session metadata.

classes.name: SqlSessionStore
classes.description: A struct implementing session storage using SQL database, providing methods for session management.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Saves a new session to the database after validation and marshaling properties.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a session by ID or token, including associated team members.

methods.name: GetSessions
methods.description: Retrieves all sessions for a specific user, including team memberships.

methods.name: GetLRUSessions
methods.description: Retrieves least recently used sessions for a user with limit and offset.

methods.name: GetSessionsWithActiveDeviceIds
methods.description: Retrieves active sessions with device IDs that are not expired or removed.

methods.name: GetMobileSessionMetadata
methods.description: Gathers metadata about mobile sessions, such as platform, version, and notification status.

methods.name: GetSessionsExpired
methods.description: Finds sessions that have expired based on threshold, mobile-only, and notification status filters.

methods.name: UpdateExpiredNotify
methods.description: Updates the notification status for a session.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Deletes a session by ID or token.

methods.name: RemoveAllSessions
methods.description: Deletes all sessions from the store.

methods.name: PermanentDeleteSessionsByUser
methods.description: Deletes all sessions associated with a specific user.

methods.name: UpdateExpiresAt
methods.description: Updates the expiration time of a session.

methods.name: UpdateLastActivityAt
methods.description: Updates the last activity timestamp of a session.

methods.name: UpdateRoles
methods.description: Updates roles for sessions of a user, respecting max length.

methods.name: UpdateDeviceId
methods.description: Updates device ID and expiration for a session.

methods.name: UpdateProps
methods.description: Updates session properties in the database.

methods.name: AnalyticsSessionCount
methods.description: Returns the count of active sessions.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Deletes expired sessions in batches based on expiry time.
